desk.period: Q2 fiscal year to March 2027 (quarter to 30 Sep 2026)
desk.headline: Quarterly sales up 9% to ¥13.4tn and operating profit up 34%; full-year profit forecast raised, revenue forecast trimmed
results: July–September sales rose to ¥13.44tn from ¥12.38tn and operating income to ¥1.13tn from ¥840bn (8.4% margin).
Quarterly net income fell to ¥759bn from ¥932bn; first-half net income still rose 26% to ¥2.24tn.
For the half, a weaker yen added ¥685bn to operating income, while cost items took away ¥340bn.
North America swung to a first-half operating profit of ¥166bn from a loss, but posted a small loss in Jul–Sep.
Big capital returns: ¥3.85tn of shares bought back in the half, buyback plan raised by ¥300bn to ¥1.3tn, and 1.2bn treasury shares to be cancelled.

guidance.summary: Toyota revised its full-year forecast: operating income now ¥3.9tn (from ¥3.4tn in August) and net income ¥3.57tn (from ¥3.25tn), while revenue was cut to ¥53.5tn (from ¥54tn). It assumes ¥157 to the dollar and keeps a ¥100 full-year dividend.

watch: Yen moves: the forecast assumes ¥157 per US dollar, and currency was the biggest profit driver this half.
North America profitability after a loss in the September quarter.
Progress on the enlarged ¥1.3tn share buyback.
